title: Versionshistorie und Versionsvergleich
description: As a developer, I want to see how a prompt evolved, so that I understand what changed and which version is in use.

acceptance_criteria.given: a prompt has three versions created by two different authors
acceptance_criteria.when: the author opens the version history
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 200 and lists version number, author, timestamp, status and finding count per version
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-009-version-history.feature: The version history lists all versions with metadata

acceptance_criteria.given: a version belongs to a prompt of organisation B
acceptance_criteria.when: a developer of organisation A requests that version
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 404 and no version data is returned
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-009-version-history.feature: Versions of another organisation are not readable

acceptance_criteria.given: a prompt has two versions with different content
acceptance_criteria.when: the author compares version 1 with version 2
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 200 and returns a diff of the two contents
and: neither version is modified by the comparison
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-009-version-history.feature: Older versions stay immutable and comparable
